newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Caspian starts Brazil oil companies.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Caspian starts Brazil oil companies.

text.p: -- Caspian Securities said it has initiated coverage of Brazilian oil distributors BR Distribuidora and Petroleo Ipiranga with buy and market performer ratings, respectively.

-- Caspian said in a report it set a buy rating for BR Distribuidora, Petrobras's retailing and distribution arm, at a price of $15.85. -- It set a 12-month price target for BR Distribuidora at 24 reais per 1,000, representing a U.S. dollar return of 38 percent and nominal return of 45 percent.
-- It also rated Petroleo Ipiranga as a market performer at a price of $13.92.
-- Caspian's 12-month price target for Ipiranga is 17 reais per 1,000 shares, representing a U.S. dollar return of 14 percent and a nominal return of 21 percent.
-- BR distribuidora preferred shares traded at 17.30, up 2.67 percent.
-- Petroleo Ipiranga preferred stock was quoted at 13.99, down 0.07 percent.
